topic: how much of every dollar Netflix earns goes into paying for its shows and films
storyAngle: Netflix is a content factory first; the profit is what is left after the shows are paid for.
doNotClaim: Amortization of content assets is the expensed cost of content for 2024, NOT cash spent that year; never say Netflix spent that amount in cash.
Do not compare content costs to profit as if the same measure.
Do not name any specific show.

facts.claim: Netflix 2024 amortization of content assets (the content cost expensed in the year) was $15,302 million.
facts.note: from the SEC XBRL financial report

facts.claim: Netflix 2024 income from operations was $10,418 million, about a 27% operating margin.

derived.claim: Content amortization was about 39% of revenue (15.3 / 39.0): roughly thirty nine cents of every revenue dollar.
